citations.quote: Im Kinderzimmer ist die Ecke zur Aussenwand hin seit Monaten nass, die Tapete löst sich, und es haben sich schwarze Punkte gebildet, die immer grösser werden.
Es riecht muffig, sobald man die Tür öffnet.
Ich habe vor, den Mietzins ab dem nächsten Monat nicht mehr der Vermieterin zu zahlen, sondern bei der Hinterlegungsstelle des Kantons zu hinterlegen, bis der Mangel behoben ist.

plan.because: Needed to establish the parties, property and tenancy terms.
The report says the landlord was informed, but the original notice and its contents are missing.
Evidence of when the landlord received the defect report is needed.
Dated images are needed to document the reported condition and location.
The reported visit does not establish the complete response, proposed work or access arrangements.
The reported wetness, growing black spots and musty smell activate the apparent mould branch; the cause remains open.
Heating is not mentioned; the silence policy presumes this branch absent for planning.
Health effects are not mentioned; the silence policy presumes this branch absent for planning.
A need for specialist inspection is not mentioned; the silence policy presumes this branch absent for planning. The technical cause is not established.
Rent deposit is contemplated; the communicated repair deadline, recipient and notice contents are needed to assess safeguards.

questions: When did you first notify the landlord, how was the notice delivered, and do you have proof of receipt?
Have you sent a written repair deadline to the landlord? If so, please provide it and proof of delivery.
Is there an immediate safety concern in the child's room, and when did the reported dampness first appear?
